summary: scripts/evidence-skip-report counts an unsigned run of a check whose skip is not turned on (enforce not true at the run's base) as 'shadow, unsigned' instead of 'not signed', and leaves it off the not-signed list: such a check runs whether it is signed or not.

replay.detail: A read-only report; no record, signature or gate rule changes.

schema.detail: The report's JSON gains a shadow_unsigned count per check, and its markdown table gains a 'ran: shadow, unsigned' column.

rules.detail: The gate and verifier are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Readers of the JSON get one more key; a base whose skip policy cannot be read counts as before (not_signed).
